milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to and visually identify the campfire. The campfire is at spawn-relative [8, 0, 8]. max_distance=5 ensures the player has navigated close enough to confirm the campfire, and facing_tolerance=60° ensures they are looking at it. This is preferred over position_inside_box because 'find' implies visual observation, not just proximity.

Uses count_in_box_at_most(kind='block', max_count=7) because magenta stained glass drops nothing when mined without Silk Touch, making inventory_has unusable. The shrine originally contains exactly 8 magenta_stained_glass blocks in a ring at y=2 (positions: 9-11,2,7 south wall=3; 9-11,2,9 north wall=3; 9,2,8 west=1; 11,2,8 east=1; center 10,2,8 is empty). After mining at least one block, the count drops to ≤7. The box [7,1,5] to [13,3,11] generously encompasses the glass ring with ±2 buffer in each axis.
